description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Issue a cash receipt for an individual consumer. IRREVERSIBLE on the next day: the NTS ledger changes immediately and it flows into the consumer's year-end tax deduction records; cancellation is possible on the SAME DAY only. Call without confirm first to get a preview, show it to the user, then retry with confirm=true. Never set confirm=true on your own.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after showing the preview to the user and receiving their explicit approval. Omit it on the first call to obtain the preview.

spstCnfrNoEncCntn.description: Issue-means number (발급수단번호) matching the class code, digits only. It is sent to the institution exactly as given - never encrypt or hash it, and never put an approval number here.

totaTrsAmt.description: Total transaction amount (총 거래금액, KRW as string, minimum 1)

name: hometax__cash_receipt__issue_individual
title: 현금영수증 발행 (개인)
